name: refract-suite
description: FTC robotics skill suite (Team 19859, DECODE season): citation-grounded rules compliance, structured hardware spec lookup with deterministic math, config-gated robot code generation grounded in library docs and the elite-team pattern corpus, and config-and-corpus-aware code review. Five skills over one shared foundation (season-invariant feature model, standing principles, failure-mode taxonomy, a provenance-weighted elite-team pattern corpus, a library-docs corpus, and an interface-based quickstart template).
